data.long_meaning: The name Fairfax is derived from the Old English words 'fæger' meaning fair or beautiful and 'fæh' meaning face or open. It can be interpreted as a name that represents a clear and beautiful face or an open and fair-minded individual. The name Fairfax carries the meaning “Fair, open and clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fairfax usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, open and clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
